earlier: Wyn has hidden in the lower layer for days. Everything here is far stronger than her except these grubs, and she has eaten nothing.
Her appraisal says the grubs are deadly poisonous. She has a little poison resistance, which grows each time she survives poison. Without food she will starve soon.
